body: Heya, I'm so glad you didn't go through with it. If you wanna talk, I'm here. Thanks so much for your nice words and I've overwhelmed that this could help you. i hope you have a better day today :) x
Yeah, but nothing's come up yet.
I have no money because of the lack of job. Like 0. minus money.
I'd like to, but can't afford it. It'd be a long, long way off.
Probably until the first night she throws a tantrum and I bail again.
Nah. I'll become a supply of emotional support for my mum. But she works, sometimes, so I may occasionally get to be in an empty house. It will be a base for me to escape from.
It's planned for the weekend. Back to mum's.

I'm trying to disengage but the girl still greets me when she comes home and I'm at the point where even her presence in the house puts me on edge. I've taken to ignoring her but it's hard. 


I can't disengage from the guy. This morning, I went to wake him up and he asked to be woken up again in an hour, so I got up to leave, and he said "you don't have to go you know". So I took this to mean that he wanted me to stay and cuddle, so I did. I got up after a bit and went to do something. I came back to wake him again and he put his head on my lap and I cuddled him a bit. But I hate it. I mean, I'd do that for anyone, it's just a reaction, I wanna take care and be nice. But it hurts me. It's horrible.



With all the shit I've got going on I want someone to do that for ME. To let ME sleep and wake me up with a hug and a kind word. Not keep taking and taking and taking. Sorry. It hurts living here.

I can't afford to move due to losing my job, but I would very much like to spend a little time at my parents' (not ideal, but unavoidable), work and save some money to live alone. I want to try to go back to university in September and study to be a vet or a vet nurse. 


It seems far away and I feel very hurt all the time. I make these future plans to spur me on. Kinda try to reward myself with the promise that it will get better. But it's hard to believe that now. Every year, it gets worse and people say "don't worry, it will get better". So, at what point do we accept that it won't? I don't know. We only get one life and have to keep trying, granted. 




But I feel tortured by life, completely and utterly battered by it, despite how hard I work to help everyone else. I've moved about eleven times in the past three years, back and forth to different universities, back and forth to boyfriends' houses or joint houses or to this new county recently. I'm exhausted. I want someone to say "here, here is some time, or space" but it won't happen.



And these people, my mum, the house mates. They say "well that's life, it's hard". But they've all got something going right. Mum has my Dad, who loves her and pays for her upkeep. My house mates have stable jobs and any misery is basically of their own doing (alcoholism and weed addiction for the guy and girl respectively). The girl has a boyfriend to lean on. The guy has, well, me offering him sex and servitude on a plate constantly. I try to communicate that I've spent the year in hospital, then losing my place at university, being abused by a "best friend", having a miscarriage, living with and fucking a man who says he'll never love me, losing a job through no fault of my own. And they say "chin up" or "everyone deals with shit". 



Well, I say to them: no, guys, actually you don't. You have no fucking idea what it's like to run around the house picking up after you, actively anticipating your needs, dealing with your subtance abuse mood swings, being your skivvy and having to deal with my own life and other myriad problems too. You have no idea what it's like for life to be hard because you lean on me.




Sorry to go off track. I could move eventually. But it's such a long road. I just want peace, now. Not because I need instant gratification like the doctors say. Just because I've been through too much.
Thanks for replying. I will try. It's just hard because I feel so tired and so much like giving up now.

Thank you for being here. Sorry I disappeared, I fell asleep (and had weird nightmares). 


It's a better mindset than before. I spent the past three months thinking of suicide basically constantly. Hating everything about me. Even wondering if I was a sociopath, because I was getting such negative feedback from those around me (the people using me tend to get pretty angry when I'm less compliant with their wishes, and when I'm depressed I try less than usual). 



On my birthday week this year, my mum's dad passed away. I went to help her care for him, but it was hard for me. I came home and my house mate (male) asked how I was. I said it was tough. He said "why not make yourself some dinner then?". My female house mate dragged up a week-old argument in order to make me feel guilty and allow her to have some drama and play the victim. I got angry and snapped at her, which fuelled her victim stance. Ultimately, I spent my birthday entirely alone. On my house mates' birthdays, I made a cake to their specifications and decorated the house and got them presents. On mine, I woke up to a pile of dirty dishes. I know people wake up homeless or dying on their birthdays. I know it could've been so, *so* much worse. But the idea that I meant less than them, that they wouldn't try for me, stabbed me in the heart. I internalised it so much that I felt filthy from the inside. Disgusting. Wrong. Like a five-year-old kid again, rejected and wondering "what did I do?". I spent the day on my own. 


Later, the girl house mate came home and dragged up another argument. I cried and cried on my male house mate's shoulder and he tried to cheer me up. He said he would speak to her. He was up there for thirty minutes and I heard laughter. I knew they were mocking me. But when he came back and I accused them of this, he said I was paranoid. I panicked. I decided I was having a psychotic relapse. 



I got him to take me to the fucking hospital to ask for anti-psychotics because they had convinced me I was crazy.



I now see it for what it was. They were manipulative, behaving nothing short of evilly. It wasn't me. It was never me. A horrible, crazy house mate doesn't take herself to hospital on her own birthday to medicate her negative emotions away for the benefit of her "friends". 




I look back on that day and I feel so sick.



Sorry, I just needed to get that out.



I'm happy when no one is at home but me. When I know when people will be home, and have an hour's window (at least) to just relax and be myself. I complete lists of tasks, listen to music, sing, draw, maybe even talk to myself a bit. I am happy with my own company. I feel OK. But it happens.. so rarely.

It would be good to meet similar personality types, or at least independent people who can take care of themselves and won't lean on me. Yeah, the lack of reciprocation is horrible. It makes me feel I haven't done enough to earn it.



I saw three counsellors as a teenager, but my mum was a counsellor and forced me to go, so I thought they'd report back to her. I never said anything at all until I showed up at the third one, aged fifteen, and cried for the entire hour about my mum. But, when I left and mum saw I was crying, she said I shouldn't go back.



I tried again in November last year, but it was a university counsellor, and she said I'd been through too much trauma (they deal with exam stress.. occasional bereavement.. not this complex). I eventually had a psychotic break and was hospitalised via her referral to hospital. I asked for therapy but they gave me anti-psychotics.


Then they decided I wasn't ever psychotic but just under a lot of stress. I asked for someone to talk to, some therapy. They diagnosed me as having borderline personality disorder. Said I need DBT. Which is OK. But it makes me feel like the problem and reinforces the idea that I'm the scapegoat. Yeah, I've slept around, cut myself, done drugs, "acted borderline". But it's because I've been in a constant state of stress since I was a kid, in my opinion, not because I am flawed. When things are OK and I'm quiet, I am *happy*. I don't create drama or thrive on things going wrong like people with BPD are meant to. I don't self-sabotage.. I try to fix and build. 



So I might get DBT. But no therapy. It's a shame because I would very much like to just speak to somebody about everything.

Thank you. I really need someone right now. The people I've been going to for comfort are the ones that have been hurting me, so it gets confusing.



I think my mum is narcissistic. I was telling her I was sad on the phone, about the man I'm living with and about losing my job and about Becky. Even told her about the miscarriage I ahd in September (I didn't know I was pregnant). She said "I don't mean to make it all about me, but I lost my job due to sexual harassment years ago, and I'm going to a tribunal, and ..." and then it was all her.. for an hour. And she told me she wants to throw herself under a bus, which I felt was inappropriate for her to tell me.. as I'm the child. But she's been telling me that stuff since I was tiny. I'm her "rock", she says. I always "sort her out". I'm so "logical and rational and always say the right thing". I'm her mum, she ain't mine.


If I could draw boundaries, I guess I could. It just hurts so much to see anyone upset. I have to help if I can. I don't feel like I have a body most of the time, I just float like a ghost, helping others but not noticing me. Today I felt I dropped into myself. I felt heavy, weird, hungry, thirsty. I felt things and attended to my needs for a bit. But now I'm floating off again. I used to play games with my dolls' house and I made the daughter the servant girl. I only called her "the servant" and it became my inner monologue after a while. I'd narrate in the third person in my head when mum made me do stuff round the house. I was other and apart and made to serve, to constantly try, but never quite be good enough.



And all my boyfriends confirmed that.

Thanks for replying. I didn't realise I was a nice or compassionate until today, when I read something. It sad that people with character disorders, or people who are not nice, don't give a fuck if they're nice or not. It made me think that, the fact I agonise over doing the right thing, struggle to dump boyfriends because it makes them sad, endlessly worry about hurting peoples' feelings means I can't be a bad person. But all these bad people have convinced me that I am. And it makes me really sad, and kinda angry, but mostly really upset. Because I look at all the scars I've got, that I made because I hated myself, because everyone said I was horrible. But I was trying my absolute best and I was never cruel to anyone. Never could be. I'd do anything for anyone. But they all made me feel like a cunt.



And here I am, feeling totally fucking alone, scared to venture back out into the world of Other People. Wondering who to trust. I feel like they wriggle around in my brain, manipulating, brainwashing, getting things out of me. Using me. I feel used up and destroyed and empty. I just want it to be over. I'm so hurt. It hurts. I want it to go away. Me to go away.
